title: [DOC2-16] Purview bridge never receives `ComplianceGapEntry` or `ArchiveResealEntry`
description: Review finding DOC2-16: Purview bridge never receives `ComplianceGapEntry` or `ArchiveResealEntry` (lens DOC2). Location: profiles/purview-bridge.md:403-406, :548-559, :586-598; spec/07-compliance.md:312-325, :374-386. Fix: The §8.3 stream schema carries only `ComplianceRecord`s plus blobs. Yet §9.2 alerts on `DMComplianceAuditEntry.removalAttempts`, and §5 reads `VTCComplianceAuditEntry` "from the recorder's record stream", so audit entries are used without being specified. `ComplianceGapEntry` and `ArchiveResealEntry` are never mentioned. §5.2 step 3 ("sealed form matches its `mediaCID`") fails for re-sealed media, per spec :374 ("Re-sealing changes the CID ... the signed record cannot change"). Apply the reviewer's fix. Full text: notes/review2/DOC2-verified.md and notes/review2/DOC2.md.
